output.resolution.label: Output resolution
output.resolution.help: The picture size sent to your display. Auto picks 1280x960 for 60 Hz sources (an exact 4x of 240p) and 1280x1024 for 50 Hz sources. Passthrough sends HD and PC sources unscaled.

output.frameLock.label: Frame lock
output.frameLock.help: Makes the output refresh exactly follow the console, which removes judder and tearing. Turn it off only if your display refuses the slightly non-standard rate.

output.force60.label: Force 60 Hz
output.force60.help: Outputs 50 Hz (PAL) sources at 60 Hz for displays that do not accept 50 Hz.

output.blankOnChange.label: Blank on change
output.blankOnChange.help: Shows black instead of a distorted frame while the source changes resolution.

output.aspect.label: Aspect
output.aspect.help: The shape of the picture on screen. Most consoles were designed for 4:3.

output.hPosition.label: Horizontal position
output.hPosition.help: Moves the picture left or right.

output.vPosition.label: Vertical position
output.vPosition.help: Moves the picture up or down.

output.hSize.label: Horizontal size
output.hSize.help: Makes the picture narrower or wider.

output.vSize.label: Vertical size
output.vSize.help: Makes the picture shorter or taller.

input.port.label: Input
input.port.help: Auto watches all inputs and switches to the one with a signal. RGB covers SCART, the RGBS jacks and VGA; Component is YPbPr.

input.syncThreshold.label: Sync threshold
input.syncThreshold.help: The level used to separate sync from sync-on-green or composite sync. Auto searches for a stable value; raise it if the picture rolls, lower it if it loses sync on dark scenes.

input.phase.label: Sampling phase
input.phase.help: When within each pixel the input is sampled. Adjust while watching fine detail until it is sharp and stable; Auto uses the measured best phase.

input.autoGain.label: Auto gain
input.autoGain.help: While you play, lowers the input gain whenever the brightest parts of the picture clip. It only ever darkens, and starts again for each new source. For exact levels, use Calibrate levels with a white screen instead.

input.videoLpf.label: Video LPF
input.videoLpf.help: Filters high frequencies before sampling. Auto chooses per standard; lower values soften the picture and reduce shimmer from noisy sources.

picture.brightness.label: Brightness
picture.brightness.help: Raises or lowers the whole picture.

picture.contrast.label: Contrast
picture.contrast.help: Increases or decreases the difference between dark and bright areas.

picture.sharpness.label: Sharpness
picture.sharpness.help: Emphasises edges. Off shows the source as sampled.

picture.scanlines.label: Scanlines
picture.scanlines.help: Darkens every other output line pair to imitate a CRT. Works on progressive 15 kHz sources.

picture.deinterlace.label: Deinterlacer
picture.deinterlace.help: How interlaced pictures are rebuilt. Motion adaptive keeps still detail sharp; Bob has no combing artefacts and the least processing.

system.language.label: Language
system.language.help: The language of the web page and the display. The serial console is always English.

system.oledSaver.label: Display saver
system.oledSaver.help: Turns the display off after a period without use, to protect the OLED from burn-in.

system.encoderReverse.label: Reverse knob
system.encoderReverse.help: Swaps the direction of the knob.

system.revertSeconds.label: Confirm within
system.revertSeconds.help: How long you have to confirm a change that could leave the screen black before it is undone.

system.showAdvanced.label: Show advanced
system.showAdvanced.help: Shows the settings for sampling, sync and diagnostics.

system.startupProfile.label: Startup profile
system.startupProfile.help: The profile loaded when the board starts: the last one used, one chosen automatically from the incoming signal, or a fixed profile.
